items.title: New Botnet Leverages DNS Misconfiguration to Launch Massive Cyber Attack

items.title: Hackers Bypassing Windows Mark of the Web Files Using LNK Stomping Attack
items.description: A sophisticated attack technique called LNK Stomping has emerged as a critical threat to Windows security, exploiting a fundamental flaw in how the operating system handles shortcut files to bypass security controls. items.title: Massive Cyber-Attack Attacking macOS Users via GitHub Pages to Deliver Stealer Malware
items.description: A sophisticated cyber-attack campaign exploiting GitHub Pages to distribute the notorious Atomic stealer malware to macOS users.
